commits_pushed_to_dev.message: fix(processing): async Celery dispatch with parallel progress, batch-scoped percent, timestamps; fix(review-scan): filename label and full-height layout
fix(workers): fall back to object storage when celery-worker lacks local upload cache
fix(workers): raise process_document time budget and celery-worker concurrency to 4

HR-10_processing_current_batch_duplicate.symptom: 3 uploaded files showed as 6 rows mixed with historical documents.
HR-10_processing_current_batch_duplicate.fix: Added state.currentProcessingBatchIds captured from the upload response (result.documents ids). getProcessingBatchDocs() scopes the summary/percent to exactly that batch (or, if no batch is tracked yet, to whatever is still status uploaded/processing/failed) instead of all historical rows.

HR-11_processing_runtime_contract_not_ac.symptom: Screen said synchronous / not through Celery, and code called POST /v1/documents/{id}/process sequentially.
HR-11_processing_runtime_contract_not_ac.fix: processOneDocument()/startProcessingAll() now call POST /api/v1/tasks/process-document/{id} (Celery dispatch) and poll GET /api/v1/tasks/{task_id}. startProcessingAll() runs a bounded worker pool (MAX_CONCURRENT_PROCESSING = 5) instead of a sequential for-loop with await per document. Banner text updated to state real Celery behavior.

HR-12_processing_history_presentation.symptom: Historical documents present but with no timestamp, so old + new looked identical/duplicated.
HR-12_processing_history_presentation.fix: Added a created_at column (formatDateTime helper) to the Processing table and to the Review Scan list. Summary text explicitly notes when the batch is a subset of the company's total document count.

HR-13_processing_feedback_no_progress.symptom: No visible progress once a document started processing.
HR-13_processing_feedback_no_progress.fix: Backend: run_pipeline() now accepts progress_callback and emits "ocr" / "extract" / "mapping" stage names; process_document Celery task reports them via task.update_state(PROGRESS). GET /api/v1/tasks/{task_id} now returns a stage field. Frontend shows per-row stage labels (รอคิว.../กำลังรัน OCR.../กำลังสกัดข้อมูล.../กำลังจัดสมุดบัญชี...) while a task is in flight.

HR-14_review_scan_label_invoice_number_n.symptom: Left document list showed invoice_number || filename, backwards for the review flow.
HR-14_review_scan_label_invoice_number_n.fix: renderReviewScanList() now renders doc.filename as the primary line (block, truncated with ellipsis) with created_at as a muted secondary line. invoice_number is no longer used for the primary label.

HR-15_review_scan_layout_too_short.symptom: Preview/detail area was a fixed 320px box, cramped.
HR-15_review_scan_layout_too_short.fix: Review Scan grid wrapper now uses height:calc(100vh - 260px) with align-items:stretch; doc list, file preview, and field-form panels stretch to fill it with internal overflow scrolling. Live-measured preview box height on SIT: ~898px (previously a fixed 320px).

additional_real_bugs_found_and_fixed_dur.bug: celery-worker container has no shared volume with the backend container, so the local upload cache written at upload time is absent in the worker; process_document previously raised FileNotFoundError and retried 3x (60s apart) before failing every single document.
additional_real_bugs_found_and_fixed_dur.fix: src/backend/workers/tasks.py _resolve_local_path() now falls back to downloading the file from object storage (MinIO) by storage_key, mirroring the existing _materialize_coa_source() pattern used by the COA async job.
additional_real_bugs_found_and_fixed_dur.evidence: Confirmed via celery-worker container logs on SIT: FileNotFoundError disappeared after the fix; tasks proceeded to real pipeline execution.

additional_real_bugs_found_and_fixed_dur.bug: process_document had no explicit Celery time_limit/soft_time_limit override, inheriting the app-wide 120s/180s defaults from celery_app.py. Real OCR + Stage C LLM escalation runs exceeded 120s and were killed with SoftTimeLimitExceeded, marking documents failed.
additional_real_bugs_found_and_fixed_dur.fix: Added time_limit=600, soft_time_limit=540 to process_document's task decorator, matching the budget already used by extract_coa_pdf.
additional_real_bugs_found_and_fixed_dur.evidence: Confirmed via celery-worker logs: 'Soft time limit (120s) exceeded' before the fix; no such warning in the run after the fix, and documents reached review_scan status.

additional_real_bugs_found_and_fixed_dur.bug: celery-worker concurrency was hardcoded to 2 in docker/docker-compose.sit.yml, undermining the point of parallel dispatch.
additional_real_bugs_found_and_fixed_dur.fix: Raised to --concurrency=4 (matches the SIT VPS's 4 vCPUs; the box is shared with several other unrelated services, so 4 was chosen over the user's requested 4-10 range to avoid starving other production services on the same host, not because Celery/Redis has any lower limit).
additional_real_bugs_found_and_fixed_dur.note_for_codex: If genuinely higher throughput is needed later, the correct fix is a dedicated worker host/VPS, not pushing concurrency higher on this shared 4-vCPU box.
